EduCore is now a working learning management system, live at educore.gorgy.org. It brings learners, families, teachers and school leaders into one platform, in English, French and Arabic.

Visit EduCore
Watch the 2-minute demo

Watch the 2-minute demo

The problem

Good teaching needs structure: a clear curriculum, content that builds step by step, and assessments that show what students have really understood — without burying teachers in admin.

What EduCore is

EduCore is an educational technology initiative designed to make teaching, learning, and assessment more structured, interactive, and accessible.

It has grown into a complete learning platform: a branded public site, a personal workspace for every role, course building, assessments, a Teaching Hub, learning analytics and student support — with operations, backups and updates built in from day one.

Key features

For learners

  • A personal dashboard with overall progress, a weekly goal and one-click “Continue learning”.
  • “Coming up”: assessments, assignments and check-ins for the next two weeks, overdue items first.
  • A distraction-free lesson reader with course outline, notes and bookmarks; progress saves on every device.
  • Timed quizzes with clear rules, automatic saving and instant results for auto-marked questions.
  • Course announcements, course ratings, certificates and a full learning history.
  • English, French and Arabic, with a fully mirrored right-to-left interface.

For families

  • A guardian view of each linked child: progress per course, upcoming deadlines and released results.
  • Attendance and the support plans the school chooses to share, with a weekly e-mail summary of changes.

For instructors

  • Course Studio: a six-step guided builder for course details, objectives, units, lessons and publishing.
  • A versioned question bank with ten question types, learner preview and import from Excel, Moodle XML or GIFT.
  • One-step announcements to every enrolled learner — on the course page, in My learning and by e-mail.
  • Learning analytics with an at-risk list that explains why, and support plans with an owner and a follow-up date.

For teachers and tutors

  • A Teaching Hub overview of what needs attention today.
  • One grading queue for assignments and essay answers, with feedback, controlled release and “return for revision”.
  • Attendance registers in seconds, plus tutoring sessions and classes.

For academic managers

  • Programmes organised by year, semester and subject, with completion at a glance.
  • Bulk enrolment from a spreadsheet: every line is checked first, nothing is created until confirmed.
  • Institution-wide analytics for participation, completion and grading backlog.

For administrators

  • A live system-health page for the server, database, backups and security settings.
  • Verified backups with restore tests that never touch live data.
  • Signed, verified updates delivered through a private release channel.
  • Roles and permissions per responsibility, and an audit trail of who changed what.

Screens from the platform

Technologies and architecture

Current build

  • WordPress, with a custom EduCore block theme and eight modular EduCore plugins (core, workspace, assessments, Teaching Hub, analytics, certificates, notifications, backup and recovery).
  • A signed release channel: every update package is cryptographically verified before it is installed.
  • Automated quality gates: unit tests, static checks and 13 end-to-end browser test suites on every release.
  • Accessible, bilingual design using IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Sans Arabic.
  • AI-assisted content and software development tools.

Planned

  • Paid courses and subscriptions (prepared, not yet activated).
  • A standalone mobile application built with Flutter and SQLite — proposed, not yet released.

Current status

Version 1.4.11 is live in production at educore.gorgy.org (November 2026), and a pilot with a first group of learners and staff is being prepared.

What I learned

Teaching AI made me understand AI differently — and building for the classroom keeps the technology honest.

Visit EduCore at educore.gorgy.org
